parts.zh: 科学家警告称，一种毒刺强度足以致人死亡的有毒鱼类正在入侵地中海
M: 我也很高兴见到你
W: 嗯，我来这儿是想向您展示我们公司能为您做些什么
W: 我们为企业提供各方面的建议
M: 好的，当然。这是我祖父在1950年创办的家族企业
W: 我明白了。这很有意思
M: 实际上出乎意料地便宜
W: 太好了。如果你不介意的话

items.stem: What is reported in the news?

choices.text: Many people have been attacked by Devil Firefish.
choices.zh: 许多人遭到魔鬼火鱼的攻击。

choices.text: The Mediterranean is a natural habitat of Devil Firefish.
choices.zh: 地中海是魔鬼火鱼的天然栖息地。

choices.text: Invasive species are driving away certain native species.
choices.zh: 入侵物种正在驱逐某些本地物种。

choices.text: A deadly fish has been spotted in the Mediterranean waters.
choices.zh: 地中海水域发现了一种致命鱼类。

items.stem: What is the environmentalist concerned about the spread of Devil Firefish in the Mediterranean?

choices.text: It could badly pollute the surrounding waters.
choices.zh: 它可能严重污染周围水域。

choices.text: It could pose a threat to other marine species.
choices.zh: 它可能对其他海洋物种构成威胁。

choices.text: It could disrupt the food chains there.
choices.zh: 它可能破坏那里的食物链。

choices.text: It could add to greenhouse emissions.
choices.zh: 它可能增加温室气体排放。

items.stem: What will happen on World Car-Free Day in Paris?

choices.text: Cars will not be allowed to enter the city.
choices.zh: 汽车将不被允许进入该城市。

choices.text: Pedestrians will have free access to the city.
choices.zh: 行人将可以免费进入该城市。

choices.text: About half of its city center will be closed to cars.
choices.zh: 该城市约一半的市中心将对汽车关闭。

choices.text: Buses will be the only vehicles allowed on its streets.
choices.zh: 公共汽车将是其街道上唯一允许通行的车辆。

items.stem: What motivated the mayor of Paris to promote the first World Car-Free Day in her city?

choices.text: The unbearable traffic noise.
choices.zh: 难以忍受的交通噪音。

choices.text: The worsening global warming.
choices.zh: 日益恶化的全球变暖。

choices.text: The ever-growing cost of petrol.
choices.zh: 不断增长的汽油成本。

choices.text: The rising air pollution in Paris.
choices.zh: 巴黎不断上升的空气污染。

items.stem: What happened to the Philippine fisherman one day?

choices.text: His house was burnt down in a fire.
choices.zh: 他的房子在一场火灾中被烧毁了。

choices.text: Many of his possessions were stolen.
choices.zh: 他的许多财物被盗了。

choices.text: His good luck charm sank into the sea.
choices.zh: 他的幸运符沉入了海里。

choices.text: His fishing boat got wrecked on a rock.
choices.zh: 他的渔船在一块岩石上失事了。

items.stem: What was the fisherman forced to do?

choices.text: Change his fishing locations.
choices.zh: 改变他的捕鱼地点。

choices.text: Find a job in a travel agency.
choices.zh: 在一家旅行社找一份工作。

choices.text: Sell the pearl he had kept for years.
choices.zh: 出售他保存多年的珍珠。

choices.text: Spend a few nights on a small island.
choices.zh: 在一个小岛上度过几个晚上。

items.stem: What did the fisherman learn from the tourist agent?

choices.text: His pearl could be displayed in a museum.
choices.zh: 他的珍珠可以在博物馆展出。

choices.text: His monstrous pearl was extremely valuable.
choices.zh: 他的巨型珍珠极其珍贵。

choices.text: The largest pearl in the world weighs 14 pounds.
choices.zh: 世界上最大的珍珠重14磅。

choices.text: A New York museum has the world's biggest pearl.
choices.zh: 纽约的一家博物馆拥有世界上最大的珍珠。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman's company?

choices.text: It boasts a fairly long history.
choices.zh: 它拥有相当悠久的历史。

choices.text: It has over 50 business partners.
choices.zh: 它有超过50个业务合作伙伴。

choices.text: It has 75 offices around the world.
choices.zh: 它在全球有75个办事处。

choices.text: It produces construction materials.
choices.zh: 它生产建筑材料。

items.stem: What does the man say about his own company?

choices.text: It was started by his father.
choices.zh: 它是由他父亲创办的。

choices.text: It has about 50 employees.
choices.zh: 它有大约50名员工。

choices.text: It is over 100 years old.
choices.zh: 它已有100多年的历史。

choices.text: It is a family business.
choices.zh: 它是一家家族企业。

items.stem: What is the main problem with the man's company?

choices.text: Outdated product design.
choices.zh: 产品设计过时。

choices.text: Loss of competitive edge.
choices.zh: 丧失竞争优势。

choices.text: Shortage of raw material supply.
choices.zh: 原材料供应短缺。

choices.text: Legal disputes in many countries.
choices.zh: 在许多国家存在法律纠纷。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest doing to help the man's company?

choices.text: Introducing innovative marketing strategies.
choices.zh: 引入创新的营销策略。

choices.text: Seeking new ways to increase its exports.
choices.zh: 寻求新的方式来增加出口。

choices.text: Providing training for its staff members.
choices.zh: 为其员工提供培训。

choices.text: Conducting a financial analysis for it.
choices.zh: 为其进行财务分析。

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?

choices.text: She is a real expert at house decorations.
choices.zh: 她是房屋装饰方面的真正专家。

choices.text: She is really impressed by the man's house.
choices.zh: 她对这位男士的房子印象深刻。

choices.text: She is well informed about the design business.
choices.zh: 她对设计行业非常了解。

choices.text: She is attracted by the color of the sitting room.
choices.zh: 她被起居室的颜色所吸引。

items.stem: Where did the man get his ideas for the project?

choices.text: From a construction businessman.
choices.zh: 从一位建筑商人那里。

choices.text: From his younger brother Greg.
choices.zh: 从他的弟弟Greg那里。

choices.text: From home design magazines.
choices.zh: 从家居设计杂志上。

choices.text: From a professional interior designer.
choices.zh: 从一位专业室内设计师那里。

items.stem: What did the man say about the project he recently completed?

choices.text: The cost was affordable.
choices.zh: 费用是可以承受的。

choices.text: The style was fashionable.
choices.zh: 风格是时尚的。

choices.text: The effort was worthwhile.
choices.zh: 付出的努力是值得的。

choices.text: The effect was unexpected.
choices.zh: 效果是出乎意料的。

items.stem: Why does the woman invite the man to her house next week?

choices.text: She'd like him to talk with Jonathan about a new project.
choices.zh: 她想让他和Jonathan谈谈一个新项目。

choices.text: She'd like to show him around her newly-renovated house.
choices.zh: 她想带他参观她新装修的房子。

choices.text: She wants to discuss the house decoration budget with him.
choices.zh: 她想和他讨论房屋装修预算。

choices.text: She wants him to share his renovation experience with her.
choices.zh: 她想让他分享他的装修经验。

items.stem: What does England spend an annual three million pounds on?

choices.text: Paying hospital bills for emergency cases.
choices.zh: 支付急诊病例的住院费用。

choices.text: Doing research on ear, nose and throat diseases.
choices.zh: 研究耳鼻喉疾病。

choices.text: Removing objects from patients' noses and ears.
choices.zh: 从患者的鼻子和耳朵中取出异物。

choices.text: Providing routine care for small children.
choices.zh: 为幼儿提供常规护理。

items.stem: What do we learn from England's Hospital Episode Statistics?

choices.text: Children aged one to four are often more curious than older children.
choices.zh: 一到四岁的儿童往往比年龄较大的儿童更有好奇心。

choices.text: Five- to nine-year-olds are the most likely to put things in their ears.
choices.zh: 五到九岁的儿童最有可能把东西塞进耳朵里。

choices.text: Many children like to put foreign objects in their mouths.
choices.zh: 许多儿童喜欢把异物放进嘴里。

choices.text: Many children like to smell things they find or play with.
choices.zh: 许多儿童喜欢闻他们找到或玩耍的东西。

items.stem: What is generally believed to account for children putting things in their ears or noses?

choices.text: They want to attract attention.
choices.zh: 他们想吸引注意力。

choices.text: They tend to act out of impulse.
choices.zh: 他们往往出于冲动行事。

choices.text: They are unaware of the potential risks.
choices.zh: 他们没有意识到潜在的风险。

choices.text: They are curious about these body parts.
choices.zh: 他们对这些身体部位感到好奇。

items.stem: What did ReBicycle do to help Leila Rahimi?

choices.text: It gave her a used bicycle.
choices.zh: 它给了她一辆二手自行车。

choices.text: It paid for her English lessons.
choices.zh: 它支付了她的英语课程费用。

choices.text: It delivered her daily necessities.
choices.zh: 它配送了她的日常生活必需品。

choices.text: It provided her with physical therapy.
choices.zh: 它为她提供了物理治疗。

items.stem: What is ReBicycle doing to help those in need?

choices.text: Expanding bike-riding lessons.
choices.zh: 扩大自行车骑行课程。

choices.text: Providing free public transport.
choices.zh: 提供免费公共交通。

choices.text: Offering walking tours to visitors.
choices.zh: 为游客提供步行游览。

choices.text: Asking local people for donations.
choices.zh: 向当地居民募捐。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about ReBicycle?

choices.text: It is a sports club.
choices.zh: 它是一个体育俱乐部。

choices.text: It is a language school.
choices.zh: 它是一所语言学校。

choices.text: It is a counseling center.
choices.zh: 它是一个咨询中心。

choices.text: It is a charity organization.
choices.zh: 它是一个慈善组织。

items.stem: What do NASA scientists want to learn about?

choices.text: How animals deal with lack of gravity.
choices.zh: 动物如何应对失重状态。

choices.text: How mice interact in a new environment.
choices.zh: 小鼠如何在新环境中互动。

choices.text: How low gravity affects the human body.
choices.zh: 低重力如何影响人体。

choices.text: How mice imitate human behavior in space.
choices.zh: 小鼠如何在太空中模仿人类行为。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the mice at the beginning of the experiment?

choices.text: They found the space in the cage too small to stay in.
choices.zh: 它们发现笼子里的空间太小而无法待在里面。

choices.text: They found it difficult to figure out where they were.
choices.zh: 它们发现很难弄清楚自己在哪里。

choices.text: They were not used to the low-gravity environment.
choices.zh: 它们不适应低重力环境。

choices.text: They were not sensitive to the changed environment.
choices.zh: 它们对改变的环境不敏感。

items.stem: What was observed about the mice on the eleventh day of the experiment?

choices.text: They continued to behave as they did in the beginning.
choices.zh: 它们继续像开始时那样行动。

choices.text: They already felt at home in the new environment.
choices.zh: 它们已经在新环境中感到自在了。

choices.text: They had found a lot more activities to engage in.
choices.zh: 它们找到了更多可以参与的活动。

choices.text: They tried everything possible to escape from the cage.
choices.zh: 它们尝试了一切可能的方法逃离笼子。

items.stem: What did the scientists find about the mice from the experiment?

choices.text: They changed their routines in space.
choices.zh: 它们在太空中改变了自己的日常习惯。

choices.text: They began to eat less after some time.
choices.zh: 它们一段时间后开始吃得更少。

choices.text: They behaved as if they were on Earth.
choices.zh: 它们的行为表现得就像在地球上一样。

choices.text: They repeated their activities every day.
choices.zh: 它们每天重复自己的活动。
